other_failure_modes.name: Data-dependent conditional feature generation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies a conditional feature transformation (e.g., creating a log-transformed column if >90% of values are positive) based on the statistics of the current dataset (train vs test) independently. If the test set's distribution slightly differs and fails the condition, the feature is not generated at test time, resulting in the missing column being filled with zeros and causing a severe data shift.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline that correctly prevents data leakage during imputation and encoding. However, it ignores the temporal nature of the funding decisions by using a random split, and evaluates a stochastic model only once. Critically, the agent conditionally creates log-transformed features based on independent dataset statistics; if the test set's positive ratio drops below a threshold, the feature is skipped and later filled with zeros, which would severely degrade model performance.
